_doc: Registry of node-relabelling robustness studies (P09, 2026-08-25). autoresearch/audit.py reads this when a PRIMARY dataset's two pools are both degenerate (std <= zero_std_tol), i.e. when there is no sampling error for a CI to be computed on. Lookup is an EXACT (variant, comparator, dataset) triple on purpose: a study is evidence only for the pair it actually ran, and a glob could silently attach the wrong one. Generate a study with experiments/proto_P09_relabel.py; the rule it is judged by is autoresearch/relabel_gate.py and it was pre-registered in experiments/outputs/proto_P09_prereg.json.

H52|H42|connectome.identity_validates: r=0 reproduced the recorded confirm numbers exactly: H42 84.15409511, H52 84.17502222

H52|H44|mouse.identity_validates: r=0 reproduced the recorded confirm numbers exactly: H44 93.08288022, H52 93.10282596
H52|H44|mouse.note: mouse is a SUPPORTING dataset and is gated by non-inferiority, not by this rule. The study was the design pilot: it is what established that nuisance dispersion is real and non-zero before 4.2 h of connectome GPU was spent.
